decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 09/E24/101, 09/E24/110, 09/E24/111, 09/E24/201, 09/E24/202, 09/E24/210, 09/E24/211 - received 3rd June 2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The basement extension to the dwelling hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 34 Park Road, Chiswick, W4 3HH.
Condition : 5 - The proposed basement should at no time be used for sleeping accommodation

Condition : 6 - No excavation or construction work shall be undertaken prior to the submission and approval in writing by the Local Planning Authority, of a Construction Method Statement, which is certified by a qualified professional giving details of excavation, temporary works and construction techniques, including details of potential impacts on neighbouring land based on assessment of the geology and hydrology of the area.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and creation of a basement area with front lightwell and stairs down to basement at the rear of the house.
